name: web-icon-tab-bar-above-big-visitors-stat-card
title: Segmented tabs Daily, Weekly, Monthly (active) and Yearly with icons above a card '32,156 Visitors this month'
whatItIs: A white page with a grey rounded track of four icon tabs where Monthly is a white raised pill, and below a rounded bordered card with a large bold '32,156' and a grey caption 'Visitors this month'.
whatItMeans: Simple and tactile; the number swaps with the selected period.

vocabulary.definition: Tabs switching a metric's time range.
The active tab shown as a white capsule.
A card with one big metric.
A grey line describing a figure.
